systemicFindings.finding: 依使用者指定 GeoGebra 參考標準，既有通用流程按鈕、純文字選擇與文字 fallback 不再構成互動教學 PASS；全部 1027 implementation-scope units 必須逐單元重新驗證單元專屬視覺模型與直接操作造成的同步視覺變化。

implementation/runtime/student-lesson-shell.js renders UnitImplementationSpec fields but does not load/render lesson teaching.body or content.sections. Authored lesson text therefore cannot be presumed visible on the formal workbench student page.

renderer-registry.js has dedicated interactive DOM only for DataExplorerBlock and GenreReadingBlock in the inspected code; TextEvidenceBlock falls back to generic text model/prompt/rule rendering, so spec-level claims of manipulation/visual synchronization require unit-by-unit runtime verification.
